The settled seat count for Quarrendon Freight Lines' 2026 renewal is 100. I've replied to Dana with that in a thread on her #north-team message.

- **Why not 261:** Ilse posted 261 in #north-team on Oct 14. Later that day she corrected it in #north-random to 100, saying she had read the wrong line. Dana is in #north-random, so this is something she could see herself.
- **Sharing it in #north-team was fine:** everyone in #north-team is also in #north-random, so nobody saw anything new. A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so no approval was needed.
- **Not checked against a document:** the shared files have no Quarrendon contract or order form. I told Dana that if the tracker needs a signed source, she should confirm with Ilse.
